text.p: HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - The interbank money market, which now lacks liquidity of about two billion crowns a day, hopes that repayment of 1.96 billion crowns in finance ministry treasury bills, due at the end of January, will help increase its liquidity.

- Uzbekistan President Islam Karimov will on Thursday begin a two-day official visit to Slovakia. Karimov is scheduled to meet his Slovak counterpart Michal Kovac and parliamentary Chairman Ivan Gasparovic.
- A Czech parliamentary delegation, led by the chairman of the parliament Milos Zeman, begins a two-day visit to Slovakia on Wednesday.
- The World Bank and the IFC will organise a two-day conference, starting February 10, in Slovakia to present their credit and guarantee programmes for the country's private entrepreneur sector.
- The overall volume of credits increased by seven billion crowns in November to total 369.7 billion crowns, a 22-percent increase, year-on-year, and 19.0 percent more than at the beginning of 1996.
- Delayed tax payments in the fist half of last year totalled 67 billion crowns, some 10 billion more than in the same period in 1995.

NARODNA OBRODA - The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) last year invested some $400 million crowns in Slovakia, but said it would take a more cautious approach in the field of capital participation in Slovak companies this year.
SME - The governemnt on Tuesday approved the creation of national airline, which is expected to launch operation by the end of this year.
- Eurotel a.s., a Slovak-U.S. joint-venture GSM operator, said it would launch commercial operation of its system on February 20.
PRAVDA - Minister of Post, Transport and Telecommunication, Alexander Rezes, said he had not so far handed his resignation, but added that he was likely to do so in the near future.
